description: This source file contains a suite of stress and concurrency tests for the ConcurrentLruCache class in the Orleans.Caching namespace. It tests thread-safety, integrity under load, and cache consistency. The tests are implemented using xUnit framework and include utility methods for multithreading and validation.

classes.name: ConcurrentLruCacheSoakTests
classes.description: Contains multiple concurrent and stress tests for the ConcurrentLruCache class to ensure thread safety and data integrity during high load scenarios.

classes.name: RepeatAttribute
classes.description: Custom xUnit data attribute to run a test multiple times for robustness and repeated validation.

classes.name: Threaded
classes.description: Utility class providing static methods to run actions or async functions concurrently across multiple threads for testing purposes.

methods.name: RunIntegrityCheck
methods.description: Verifies the internal consistency and integrity of the cache's data structures and queues.

methods.name: Setter
methods.description: Background task to continually update the cache with new GUID values to simulate concurrent updates.

methods.name: Checker
methods.description: Utility method to repeatedly attempt to get a cache item, aiding in detecting live lock or race conditions during concurrency tests.
